cohort: Patients presented with a live singleton fetus in breech presentation on third-trimester ultrasound
finding: While ECV significantly decreased the breech rate, it did not significantly reduce the cesarean section rate after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: While attempting external cephalic version (ECV) for breech presentation did not significantly reduce cesarean section rates overall, it did significantly reduce cesarean section rates in the subgroup of primiparous women.
